name: o22092

serverTarget.description: Server target to use for prerendering the app.

routesFile.description: The path to a file containing routes separated by newlines.

guessRoutes.description: Whether or not the builder should extract routes and guess which paths to render.

numProcesses.description: The number of cpus to use. Defaults to all but one.

description:
The prerender job will use the **myapp:build** target for the client bundle and the **myapp:server** target for server‑side rendering.  

We will explicitly render the three routes — `/`, `/about` and `/contact` — while also enabling automatic route guessing. The process will run on three CPU cores, leaving the remaining cores free for other work.
